title: What showed up was what the product picture on amazon.
text: What showed up was what the product picture on amazon.. The item delivered had deep gashes, not just scratches on the surface; the color was paler in comparison to the product’s photo.  Since I was using it to catch incense ashes, I could cover up the gashes.  I pay a nominal price for this item, so it wasn’t worth returning it.  I certainly would return it if I had paid full price.  A real shame, if I were sent the item that looked like the product pic, I would have been very happy.

product_metadata.title: Earthly Home Wooden Decorative Leaf Design Serving Tray - Natural Finish - Size: 12 x 8 x 1 Inches - Intricate Detail with Hand Carving Creates a Truly Unique Furnishing Accent
features: CONTENTS: One Mango wooden Leaf Design decorative serving Tray. Color: Natural.
High quality solid Mango wood construction.
Intricate detail with hand carving creates a truly unique furnishing accent. Clean with a soft, dry cloth.

AGE-OLD ART: 400 year old art of wood carving , started in the Mughal era by the artisans of Saharanpur, India has now evolved into an industry with 1 lakh artisans working together seamlessly to create world’s finest handicrafts.
description: Featuring a rustic wooden construction with a Natural brown finish, this multipurpose tray will be a stylish accent for your home or office. The interior space of the tray is large enough to hold magazines or documents, making it a practical way to organize any loose papers cluttering your work space. However, this tray can also be paired with candles or other decor to create a stylish centerpiece on a dining table or coffee table. Whether you decide to use this tray to display decor, organize paperwork, or serve drinks, you can enjoy the charming vintage style it has to offer. Approximate Dimensions 12 x 8 x 1 Inches
